description.en: Apply for a new electricity connection for a house or flat.
description.ta: வீடு அல்லது அடுக்ககத்திற்கு புதிய மின் இணைப்புக்கு விண்ணப்பிக்க.
description.hi: घर या फ्लैट के लिए नए बिजली कनेक्शन का आवेदन।
description.or: ଘର ବା ଫ୍ଲାଟ ପାଇଁ ନୂଆ ବିଦ୍ୟୁତ୍ ସଂଯୋଗ ଆବେଦନ।

submit_note: Apply online on the TANGEDCO/TNPDCL new-connection portal or at your section office. Keep the application number to track it. Other states' electricity boards ask for very similar details.

question.en: What is the full address of the place that needs the connection?

fields.explain: The address where the meter will be installed (door number, street, area, city).

question.en: Do you own this place, or are you renting it?

fields.explain: Tenants can apply too, but need the owner's consent letter and a rent agreement.
The owner of the premises, as on the sale deed or patta.

question.en: What kind of building is it?

fields.explain: Larger buildings and apartments may need a completion certificate or plan approval.

question.en: Single phase or three phase supply?

fields.explain: Single phase is enough for most homes (lights, fans, fridge, TV). Three phase is for heavy loads like several ACs, big motors or machines.

question.en: What is the total connected load in kW? If you don't know, just list your appliances (for example '4 fans, 1 fridge, 1 AC') and I'll estimate it.

fields.explain: Connected load is the total power of all appliances you'll use, in kilowatts (1 kW = 1000 watts). Example: 4 fans (75 W each) + 6 LED lights (15 W) + fridge (200 W) + TV (100 W) = about 0.69 kW.

question.en: What is the built-up area of the premises in square feet?

fields.explain: The covered floor area, as on your building plan or property tax receipt.

documents: Ownership proof: sale deed, patta or latest property tax receipt
If tenant: owner's consent (NOC) letter and rent agreement
Building completion certificate / plan approval, where required for apartments and larger buildings
